events.n: likely executed in Hawaii during the summer stay in Honolulu
events.q: Both Ernst and Tanning produced many works while in Hawaii, and the present lot—with a warm sun bathing the ocean and sky with an orange glow—is reminiscent of their stay, likely executed while on the island.
